verdicts.reason: A rearranges for the 320x50 strip: 'DENTAL SERVICES' sits on one line, big and readable, and the woman and tooth stay on the right. But the small teeth on the left are bunched into a messy cluster against the edge, the headline nearly touches the graphics on both sides, and most of the airy tooth pattern from the original is gone. B is just the original shrunk: the two-line headline is tiny and hard to read at this size, the woman figure is very small, and the wide white tooth shapes take up more room than the message. It keeps the original look but fails readability and hierarchy.
